title: Discover
text: We dig into your goals, users and constraints, then agree on scope, timeline and a fixed quote.

title: Design
text: Wireframes and clickable prototypes let you see and test the product before a line of code is written.

title: Build
text: Agile sprints with weekly demos, automated tests and transparent progress in a shared board.

title: Launch
text: Security checks, performance tuning and a smooth, monitored release to production.

title: Support
text: SLA-backed maintenance, monitoring and iteration so your product keeps getting better.
